title: Add due dates to to-dos
description:
To-dos can have an optional due date.

## API

- `POST /api/todos` and `PATCH /api/todos/:id` accept `dueDate` as a `YYYY-MM-DD` string. Anything else is a 400 with an `error` message. On `PATCH`, `dueDate: null` removes it.
- To-dos are returned with their `dueDate` (`null` when there isn't one).

## App

- The form has an optional date field next to the title.
- Each to-do shows its due date. Ones that are overdue (before today, and not done) are highlighted.
